annotation.title_clean: The National Artificial Intelligence Policy of the Republic of Rwanda
annotation.title_en: The National Artificial Intelligence Policy of the Republic of Rwanda
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of ICT and Innovation (MINICT); Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority (RURA)
annotation.summary_en: Rwanda's 2022 National AI Policy sets a roadmap with six priority areas (skills, compute infrastructure, data, public-sector adoption, private-sector adoption, ethics guidelines) and 14 recommendations, plus a Responsible AI Office and an implementation plan. It is general AI policy without robotics or physical-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six priority areas with 14 policy recommendations to accelerate responsible AI adoption
Establish a Responsible AI Office within MINICT to coordinate implementation
Operationalise RURA's Guidelines on Ethical Development and Implementation of AI, with AI Ethics Officers
Regulatory sandboxes and AI procurement guidelines for the public sector
Data-sharing frameworks, national skills programs and a continental AI hub with cloud infrastructure
